verdict.rationale: The only programmatic surface in the evidence is the official MCP server. It covers a narrow slice of the product: listing audits, viewing evidence requests, and adding comments, attachments and status updates to those requests. Its scope is 'within limits you set'. The UI covers far more, including Risk Register, access reviews, policy publishing, monitors, custom Unified Controls, shared controls and user/workspace administration, and none of it is shown as reachable programmatically. missing for 10: a documented public REST/GraphQL API, any stated API-to-UI parity, programmatic coverage of risks, policies, access reviews, controls, monitors and admin functions, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
